title: fix(security): patch DOMPurify dependency blocking release audit
body:
The post-merge security audit for the interaction release now detects [GHSA-p98j-92pf-mc4p](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p98j-92pf-mc4p), updated on 30 September, in the existing DOMPurify 3.4.13 transitive dependency of PostHog. Refresh only that lockfile entry to the published patched version 3.4.16. Existing dependency ranges and audit policy remain unchanged.

Validation: clean isolated `npm ci --ignore-scripts`; existing `audit-ci` configuration passes. An isolated DOM regression reproduced retained unsafe event handlers on detached subtrees in 3.4.13 for both `afterSanitizeElements` and `afterSanitizeAttributes`; 3.4.16 neutralizes both. Hosted UI/build/browser checks passed before protected merge and automatic web deployment.

The interaction focus repair (#473) is already merged and deployed as `adafd0c3795462c5b094622302658e24837fd277`. Actual production desktop, phone and WebKit checks passed keyboard cancellation, leaf deletion focus, retained parent focus/replies and axe without serious/critical violations. This dependency repair does not change the backend, schema or native artifacts.

Release status verified on 1 October: Android 22 is Active and available to existing Alpha closed-test users on Google Play (full rollout); internal track 12 is unchanged. Apple reports iOS 29 as VALID and IN_BETA_TESTING internally. Physical Android links, native write flows and TalkBack checks were subsequently verified as detailed below; physical iOS remains unverified. All production focus test accounts/content have been retired and their credentials revoked.

Final release verification, 1 October 2026:

- Independent approval by `tdfrecords` on `6a830cf74b1c9ff81fdce9814d73435ce05d0b27`; normal protected merge `49f1f0ec087067d17f62d91df1b616eb053eb894`, with a tree identical to the approved revision.
- All PR checks passed, including 2,293 web tests, 553 mobile tests and the broader persona browser suite. All six post-merge workflows passed: [safe install/security audit](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36801045510), [interaction properties](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36801045472), [social verification](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36801045442), [event verification](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36801045412), [catalog audit](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36801045497), and [monitoring](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36801045524).
- Cloudflare production deployment `190d2ccc-76c3-4206-a9eb-7c573ba446df` serves the exact merge on both canonical hosts. Entry `/assets/index-DUzxj-VG.js` SHA-256 `99a2fecf2ca7f81ac09e1f82306707d7c130c86adf67b4daeaef37d2f4f8d440` matches both public hosts and the immutable deployment. Automatic builds remain enabled; no temporary release hooks remain.
- Real production authenticated desktop, phone and WebKit flows passed keyboard cancellation, leaf deletion focus, retained-parent focus/replies and axe without serious/critical findings on this final build. A separate anonymous phone check verified the actual API origin, denied access to withdrawn content, its clear unavailable state and keyboard recovery navigation. All temporary canary sources are hidden, bodies deleted and credentials revoked.
- Both hosts return the correct Apple and Android association documents as HTTP 200 JSON without redirects, including the Apple client user agent. Subsequent physical Android handoff verification is recorded below; physical iOS handoff remains unverified.
- Backend remains the qualified `645f56fcc44f81609fbfd0e03d683b40376ce77a`; health/database OK, reviewed ledger 159, canonical interactions active and no release lease. No backend, schema, native artifact or Trader/Fly changes were necessary.

The authorized backend/web rollout and existing native testing-channel deliveries are complete. Physical iOS VoiceOver/HTTPS handoff remains open because no iPhone was available; no public-store rollout is claimed.

Physical Android verification — initial read-only phase, 1 October 2026:

- Samsung SM-S928B running Android 16, updated through Google Play from build 17 to the released Alpha build 22. Installer remains `com.android.vending`; the current app session was preserved.
- The actual installed Play signing certificate matches both live `assetlinks.json` files. Android reports `www.tdfrecords.net` and `tdf-app.pages.dev` verified with link handling allowed.
- Unrestricted HTTPS `ACTION_VIEW` intents, without a package restriction or forced association settings, cold- and warm-opened `com.tdf.records/.MainActivity` on both hosts. Actual UI assertions confirmed the exact linked reply, its parent and expanded thread. Repeated with Samsung TalkBack bound and touch exploration enabled.
- The operator explicitly confirmed the spoken “Comentario enlazado” announcement, focus on the linked reply author and reading the reply body; separately confirmed menu navigation and restored focus after closing. Samsung's first-use TalkBack phone-access prompts interrupted setup; no phone-call permission was granted. TalkBack and screen-awake settings were restored afterward.
- Physical UI checks passed thread collapse/expansion, a deleted-parent placeholder with the reply preserved, and the explicit unavailable state after withdrawing the owned test publication. Parent deletion used the temporary author's API credentials; this is not a claim of a physical compose/edit/delete journey.
- The operator requested preserving the current session and limiting device interaction to read-only checks. At the end of this read-only phase, physical composing/editing/deleting/reaction accessibility was still unverified; the subsequently authorized write phase below supersedes that limit. No iPhone was available, so physical iOS VoiceOver and signed HTTPS handoff remain unverified.
- All three temporary accounts were retired, both comment bodies erased, the publication hidden, and tokens/credentials/roles revoked. Independent database verification returned hidden=true with zero active credentials/tokens/roles and zero remaining comment bodies. No real user content or account session was changed.

This continuation required no source change, new migration, deployment, or change to Trader/shared Fly.

Physical Android verification — subsequently authorized test-account write phase, 1 October 2026:

- The operator explicitly authorized signing out the original app session and temporarily using a fresh owned test account. Login used the normal native credential form; no session injection, app data reset or saved-password entry. All actions concerned the owned temporary publication and accounts.
- Native touch actions added, changed and removed all four reactions, with authoritative server assertions after each action. Counts remained zero or one as appropriate. The selected Like control exposed selected=true in the accessibility tree.
- Native comment creation with autocomplete mention produced exactly one record, correct author and stable mentioned-user ID; the recipient received an exact-comment mention notification. Native editing incremented the version and preserved the mention.
- A separate owned actor supplied a reply. Cold-opening the actual recipient notification route and activating the native conversation action loaded its exact comment and thread, preserved the signed-in test session and marked the notification read. This verifies in-app notification navigation, not physical FCM push delivery. A native nested reply preserved its exact parent and thread root.
- The operator reported that reaction state, composer labels and keyboard/submission controls were usable with TalkBack. The named comment was initially absent from the API, so the assistant disclosed this and drove its actual native submission; the server then verified one record. Native edit and leaf/parent deletion subsequently passed with TalkBack active.
- Deletion cancellation left the edited comment intact and restored heading focus. Confirmed leaf deletion erased its body, reduced the count and restored heading focus. Confirmed parent deletion produced the deleted placeholder and preserved both replies and their exact parent/root relationships; the live count became two. Screenshots show accessible focus and both surviving replies; TalkBack was confirmed bound throughout these final deletion actions.
- The operator subsequently confirmed that TalkBack reads the deleted placeholder and both surviving replies without losing focus. This supplements the earlier operator-confirmed linked-comment announcement and menu focus checks.
- With explicit temporary permission approval, Samsung TalkBack's requested READ_PHONE_STATE permission was granted only for this phase, then revoked and independently verified denied. Original accessibility-service, accessibility-enabled and screen-awake settings were restored; no TalkBack service remains bound.
- The native test account was signed out through the normal app control, leaving the user to sign back in. The final test reaction was removed natively. All three fixture accounts were retired, all four comment bodies erased, the publication hidden, and every fixture token/credential/role revoked. Independent SQL returned hidden=true and zero active tokens, credentials, roles, comment bodies, reaction rows and reaction counters.
- Production health and database checks remained OK on the same backend release. No source changes, new migration, deployment or CI rerun were needed for this physical qualification. No iPhone was available; physical iOS VoiceOver/HTTPS handoff remains explicitly unverified.
